---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea for this project
title: "[FEATURE]: "
labels: enhancement
assignees: GentleBurr

---

**Is your feature request related to a specific problem or frustration?**
A clear and concise description of what the problem is.
> Ex. "I'm always frustrated when I try to paste links from [New Character Hub] and the script skips them."

**What exact solution or new feature would you like to see?**
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.
> Ex. "I would like Smart Import to support parsing links and metadata from [New Website]."

**What alternative solutions or workarounds have you tried so far?**
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.
> Ex. "I currently have to import them natively, which creates duplicates I have to delete manually."

**Are there any useful links, example cards, or API documentation for this request?**
If you are asking for a new character website to be supported, PLEASE link to an example character card, or better yet, their API documentation if they have it!

**Is there any additional context or screenshots you can provide?**
Add any other context about the feature request here.
